title: QUIC RFC 9000 NEW_TOKEN Frame Focused Proof Verification
verification_method: Focused S19P7 requirement-home tests, Release build, full Release no-build solution tests, QuicFrameCodec benchmark Dry run, regenerated QUIC coverage triage, SpecTrace JSON validation, and whitespace diff checking.
scope: This verification covers NEW_TOKEN parser and formatter behavior, field order, Token Length variable-length integer handling, opaque-token preservation, empty-token rejection, duplicate-token comparison, client send prohibition, and server receipt PROTOCOL_VIOLATION for RFC 9000 Section 19.7 requirements 0001 through 0010.
expected_result: Focused S19P7 requirement homes prove that NEW_TOKEN frames use type 0x07, carry Token Length and Token fields, reject malformed or empty token encodings, preserve opaque token bytes, compare duplicate repair by token bytes, prevent client-role NEW_TOKEN emission, and close server-side receipt with PROTOCOL_VIOLATION.
procedure: Run the focused S19P7 requirement-home filter.
Run the full Release no-build solution test suite.
Run the QuicFrameCodec benchmark suite with BenchmarkDotNet Dry job.
Check the resulting diff for whitespace errors.
preconditions: The existing QuicFrameCodec NEW_TOKEN parser and formatter are the wire-format seam under test.
The existing managed application-packet runtime is the role-policy seam under test.
Listener-local NEW_TOKEN envelope validation and replay enforcement remain owned by existing Section 8.1 artifact families.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification does not claim persistent replay state across listener restarts, cluster-wide anti-replay coordination, public token-cache APIs, or NEW_TOKEN envelope changes beyond the parser and managed runtime role-policy seams.

status_summary: Passed locally on 2026-05-05. The focused S19P7 requirement-home filter passed 34/34, the combined S19P7 plus S9P3 token-emission regression filter passed 38/38, regenerated triage reports 10/10 S19P7 requirements as trace_clean, Release build passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors, core SpecTrace JSON validation passed for 394 artifacts, the full Release no-build solution suite passed 4206/4206, and the QuicFrameCodec BenchmarkDotNet Dry run completed 16/16 benchmarks including ParseNewTokenFrame at 840.6 us and FormatNewTokenFrame at 340.6 us with no allocations.
